paper_title: Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models
caption: Domain distribution of our annotated AttrEval-GenSearch test set (covering 12 domains in total).
model_annotation: This pie chart represents the domain distribution of an annotated test set, encompassing a total of twelve categories. The slices are colored as follows: "Business" is dark blue (5.9%), "Geography" is light green (2.7%), "Math" is dark gray (1.2%), "Game&Anime" is orange (8.2%), "Science" is teal (6.7%), "Econ. & Fin." is cyan (18.4%), "Law" is light blue (5.1%), "History" is purple (8.2%), "Med & Health" is yellow (6.7%), "Pet & Animal" is light brown (5.5%), "AI/NLP Research" is a lighter shade of blue (24.3%), and "Daily Life" is pink (7.1%). Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. The segments appear to be ordered visually from largest to smallest, with the ‘AI/NLP Research’ slice being the largest and the "Math" slice being the smallest. A legend is included below the chart, listing the domain labels corresponding to their respective colors.
